quarterly_data.quarter: Duos Technologies press release: Duos Technologies Announces 20 MW Customer Agreement and (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Duos signed a new 10-year colocation agreement for 20 MW of facility load with a mature publicly traded cloud services provider in the United States (not named), representing over $400 million of total contract value over the initial term, expected to be deployed in Q2 2027; Duos is under contract and in active negotiations to secure approximately 100 MW of additional powered, data-center-zoned land - approximately 25 MW under contract across multiple sites and an additional 75 MW in active negotiation.
quarterly_data.figure: 20 MW; over $400 million total contract value; approximately 100 MW of land (25 MW under contract, 75 MW in negotiation)
